procedure.title: DRY Refactoring
procedure.step: Scan the file for ≥3 consecutive setAttribute calls on the same element.

Replace the calls with an Object.entries loop:
Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([k, v]) => el.setAttribute(k, v));
Apply the same pattern to ≥3 property assignments using Object.assign.
Verify no setAttribute / property-set sequence survives above the threshold.

procedure.title: Cache Repeated String Literals
procedure.step: Search the file for duplicate string literals (≥2 occurrences).

For each duplicate, declare a const at the top of the enclosing scope:
const dataGuardMsg = "data-guard-msg";
Replace every occurrence with the named constant.

procedure.title: Add Minimal JSDoc
procedure.step: Identify all function declarations and named function expressions lacking JSDoc.
Skip arrow callbacks and self-documenting one-liner arrows.

procedure.title: Collapse Sequential Declarations
procedure.step: Find ≤3 adjacent const (or let) declarations with simple initialisers.
Leave complex destructuring declarations separate.

procedure.title: Remove Single-Statement Braces
procedure.step: Find if/else blocks whose body is a single statement.

For guard + call, convert to short-circuit:
el && el.focus();

For symmetric branches, convert to ternary:
const label = isNew ? "Create" : "Update";

procedure.title: IIFE + try/catch Wrapping
procedure.step: Identify the module / route script boundaries.
Replace "erpModuleName" with the actual module/route name.

procedure.title: Optimize DOM Queries
procedure.step: List all DOM queries in the file (querySelector, querySelectorAll, etc.).

For each, check if a faster API applies:
getElementById — if selecting by ID
getElementsByClassName — if selecting by class
getElementsByTagName — if selecting by tag
form.elements / namedItem() — if inside a form
querySelector — single CSS-selector match (keep)
querySelectorAll — multi CSS-selector match (keep)
Replace the call with the higher-ranked API.

procedure.title: Add Event-Listener Guards
procedure.step: Find every addEventListener call.
Choose a descriptive dataset key: <eventType>Bound (e.g., clickBound, changeBound, submitBound).

procedure.title: Mark Vendor Files
procedure.step: Identify non-project files (libraries, third-party scripts).

Insert as the first non-empty line:
// # ! VENDOR FILE — DO NOT EDIT
Add the file path to the exclude list in tsconfig.json.
Add the file path to the ignores array in eslint.config.mjs.

procedure.title: Wrap API Calls
procedure.step: Identify raw axios/fetch calls that aren't in a dedicated function.
Name the function as <endpoint><Method> (e.g., tasksGet, invoicePost).
Move the function to an api/ module or a clearly delineated block.
Replace the original call site with a call to the new function.
If fetch is used, replace with axios.
